mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index above 3% for three consecutive months signals inflationary pressure, prompting tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained CPIAUCSL > 3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment above 5% for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of sustained PAYEMS > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts below 1,200,000 units for four consecutive months signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained HOUST < 1,200,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index below 101.0 for three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained INDPRO < 101.0 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5% for three consecutive months signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS > 5% (t-test p > 0.05).
